description: Fork of exp684 (1.4262 @ 140M, hybrid_smooth). Single change: backward_mode hybrid_smooth -> soft. Forward becomes single-row argmax with coeff=1.0 (the same kernel _soft_lut_fwd_body_einsum the hard eval on exp684 ckpt used; we measured 1.4529 collapsing exp684 to that forward). Backward stays soft (K-row soft attribution to x, soft T_soft/T_sel grads, hard index_add at chosen row for W). Tests how much of the 34 mb hard-mode penalty closes when training optimises directly for the single-row functional form. References: exp684 = 1.4262 @ 140M (hybrid_smooth, 2-row blend), exp684 collapsed-to-hard = 1.4529 (untrained-for-hard), exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (<100M SOTA).
